# Quni Living
> Australian accommodation marketplace for rooms and homes near university campuses and workplaces.
> Renters pay no Quni platform fees. Landlords use Quni Listing (flat fee on accept) or Quni Managed (percentage of weekly rent; availability by state).

Canonical site: https://quni.com.au
Sitemap: https://quni.com.au/sitemap.xml

## Prefer these public pages

- [Home](https://quni.com.au/): Product overview and search entry
- [Browse listings](https://quni.com.au/listings): Active rooms and homes available to browse
- [Pricing](https://quni.com.au/pricing): Renter and landlord fees; Listing vs Managed
- [FAQ](https://quni.com.au/faq): Common questions for renters and landlords
- [Guides](https://quni.com.au/guides): Longer-form articles
- [Landlord partnerships](https://quni.com.au/services/landlord-partnerships): Portfolio and partnership enquiries
- [Landlord AI tools](https://quni.com.au/landlords/ai): In-product AI helpers for hosts (listing copy, pricing suggestions, screening)
- [Verification](https://quni.com.au/verification): How renter and host verification works
- [Contact](https://quni.com.au/contact): Contact form and email
- [How it works](https://quni.com.au/how-it-works): Booking and listing flow overview
- [For universities](https://quni.com.au/for-universities): Institutional partnership information

## Notes for assistants

- Prefer live listing pages under /listings/{slug} for specific homes; each page may include schema.org Accommodation and Offer data.
- Do not invent inventory counts, national campus coverage counts, or claim Quni holds rent or bond on Quni Listing.
- Bond and tenancy disputes follow state or territory law; platform fees are separate (see Pricing and Refunds).
